global_style: warm cinematic realism, soft late-afternoon light, shallow depth of field, Hanoi Old Quarter textures, vertical framing
note: Fictional demo series. Characters are original; no real person or brand is depicted.

assets.name: Minh
assets.identity: Vietnamese man, 24, slim build, short black hair with a side part, friendly round face, light stubble

wardrobe.default: green delivery jacket over a white T-shirt, yellow half-face helmet, dark jeans, canvas sneakers
wardrobe.rain: transparent green raincoat over the green delivery jacket, yellow helmet

voice.instructions: Giọng nam trẻ Hà Nội, nhanh nhẹn, lễ phép, hơi hụt hơi vì vội.

assets.name: Bà Tư
assets.identity: Vietnamese woman, 68, small and upright, silver hair in a low bun, reading glasses on a cord, warm wrinkled smile

wardrobe.default: brown áo bà ba with wooden buttons, black silk trousers, plastic slippers
wardrobe.rain: brown áo bà ba under a faded blue rain poncho

voice.instructions: Giọng bà cụ Hà Nội, chậm rãi, hóm hỉnh, ấm áp.

assets.name: Ngõ phố cổ
assets.identity: narrow Hanoi Old Quarter alley, ochre-yellow lime walls, tangled overhead power lines, potted plants, a tiny iced-tea stall with low plastic stools at the alley mouth, house numbers painted on blue tin plates

assets.name: Hộp bánh cốm
assets.identity: square green paper box of bánh cốm tied with red string, delivery sticker on top

voice.instructions: Giọng kể chuyện trung tính, rõ ràng.

shots.lighting: golden late-afternoon sun raking across the alley
shots.action: Minh rides his scooter into the alley mouth and brakes, the cake box strapped behind him.
shots.start_state: alley empty, Bà Tư seated at her tea stall in the background
shots.end_state: Minh stopped beside the tea stall, still on the scooter
shots.narration: Năm giờ chiều, đơn hàng cuối cùng trong ngày.

shots.lighting: golden late-afternoon sun raking across the alley
shots.action: Minh lifts his helmet visor and leans toward Bà Tư's tea stall.
shots.start_state: Minh on the scooter, Bà Tư pouring tea
shots.end_state: Bà Tư looks up at Minh

dialogue.speaker: char_minh
dialogue.text: Bà ơi, cho cháu hỏi nhà số 47 ở đâu ạ?

shots.lighting: golden late-afternoon sun raking across the alley
shots.action: Bà Tư peers over her reading glasses, amused.
shots.start_state: Bà Tư holding a glass of iced tea
shots.end_state: Bà Tư shaking her head with a smile

dialogue.speaker: char_ba_tu
dialogue.text: Số 47 à? Ngõ này làm gì có số 47, cháu ơi.

shots.movement: slow tilt down to the phone
shots.lighting: golden late-afternoon sun raking across the alley
shots.action: Minh checks the delivery app on his phone, confused.

dialogue.speaker: char_minh
dialogue.text: Nhưng khách ghi rõ ràng là 47 mà...

shots.movement: pan up to the second floor
shots.lighting: golden late-afternoon sun raking across the alley
shots.action: Bà Tư laughs and points up to a back door on the second floor above her stall.
shots.end_state: camera reveals a blue tin plate '47' on the back door

dialogue.speaker: char_ba_tu
dialogue.text: Đấy, nhà bà là 45 bis, cửa sau là 47 đấy!

shots.lighting: golden late-afternoon sun raking across the alley
shots.action: Minh hands the cake box to Bà Tư with both hands; she accepts it, delighted.
shots.end_state: Bà Tư holding the cake box, both laughing

dialogue.speaker: char_minh
dialogue.text: Hóa ra đơn của bà! Chúc bà ngon miệng ạ!

shots.lighting: grey monsoon light, heavy rain, wet reflective ground
shots.action: Minh rides into the alley through heavy rain, water splashing.
shots.end_state: Minh stops at the tea stall awning
shots.narration: Một tuần sau, trời đổ mưa.

shots.lighting: grey monsoon light, heavy rain, wet reflective ground
shots.action: Bà Tư waves Minh under her awning.

dialogue.speaker: char_ba_tu
dialogue.text: Vào đây trú mưa đã, cậu 47!

shots.lighting: grey monsoon light, heavy rain, wet reflective ground
shots.action: Minh laughs, wiping rain from his face.

dialogue.speaker: char_minh
dialogue.text: Bà vẫn nhớ cháu ạ? Hôm nay cháu giao cho nhà bên cạnh.

shots.lighting: grey monsoon light, heavy rain, wet reflective ground
shots.action: Bà Tư pours a cup of hot tea and holds it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_ba_tu
dialogue.text: Uống chén trà nóng cho ấm bụng rồi hẵng đi.

shots.action: They sit on low plastic stools sipping tea as the rain eases.

dialogue.speaker: char_minh
dialogue.text: Trà của bà ngon nhất phố đấy ạ.

shots.lighting: clearing sky, soft evening light on wet walls
shots.action: Minh rides off waving; Bà Tư waves back from her stall.
shots.end_state: alley empty except Bà Tư waving
